subject: Request: BridgeSci OpenLab pilot credits for summer student compute
messages:
From: Dr. Lina Gomez <lina@bridgesci.org>
To: Redwood Pilot Support <pilots@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: BridgeSci OpenLab pilot credits for summer student compute

Hi Redwood team,

I lead the BridgeSci OpenLab (non-profit research collective focused on low-resource biology datasets) and we are running a short summer research program for undergrad students. We have a small grant but not enough for the compute required for a two-month pilot.

Would Redwood consider providing promotional credits (or a trial extension) to support: a) training small fine-tuning runs and b) prompting/evaluation for student projects (estimated 100k tokens/month)? We’re hoping to start the pilot Sept 6 and run through mid-November. We absolutely can provide a public acknowledgement and a short case study on completion.

Attached is a short pilot proposal (pilot-proposal-bridgesci.pdf) and a rough student roster. Happy to provide IRB language or additional compliance info if needed — we take data privacy seriously.

Best,

Lina Gomez, PhD
Director, BridgeSci OpenLab
lina@bridgesci.org
(617) 555-0123

---
Attachment: pilot-proposal-bridgesci.pdf (application/pdf, 42 KB)
Attachment: student_list_redacted.csv (text/csv, 4 KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Lina Gomez <lina@bridgesci.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: BridgeSci OpenLab pilot credits for summer student compute

Hi Lina — thanks for the note and for the proposal, this looks like a great community project. I reviewed the attached proposal quickly and I have a couple of clarifying questions before I route to our grants/credits committee:

- Confirmed start date: you mentioned Sept 6; is that the target for activation?
- Usage profile: you estimate ~100k tokens/month — is that primarily embedding/batch eval or generation? (gives us an idea of cost buckets)
- Data sensitivity: will any PII or PHI be processed? You mentioned IRB; if there’s any human subject data we’ll need the IRB letter and an SSO to our compliance team.

I can offer an initial provisional credit of $5,000 for the pilot while we complete approvals, subject to a short MOU. Marissa, Neha — can you confirm whether finance/legal need a standard MOU or if grants can be handled via our pilot credits flow?

If that works for you, Lina, I’ll open a HubSpot record and send a short DocuSign MOU for signatures. We can then activate credits the business day after the signed MOU is in.

Thanks and welcome — excited to see student projects built on Redwood.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

---
Attachment referenced: pilot-proposal-bridgesci.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Dr. Lina Gomez <lina@bridgesci.org>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2027 15:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: BridgeSci OpenLab pilot credits for summer student compute

Thanks for the context, Priyom (and Lina for the proposal). Quick note from the credits/upper-sales side:

- We can approve a $5k pilot credit for BridgeSci OpenLab, limited to platform usage (tokens/embeddings). No support budgets included.
- We need a signed MOU that contains: project name, credit amount, activation/start date, end date (credits expire 60 days after activation if unused), and a short liability clause.
- Security checklist: if the pilot ingests human-subject data, please attach IRB and data handling statement. If not, a short confirmation is fine.

Priyom — please create the HubSpot deal (BRG-OPNLAB-2027-07) and upload the MOU to DocuSign. I’ll tag finance to provision the credits once the signed MOU is in.

Lina — if you can sign the attached MOU stub quickly we’ll expedite. Also, we’ll need a contact for any billing-related questions.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Pilot Programs | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Marissa / Priyom — thank you both. I’ve signed the MOU and attached the scanned copy (bridgesci_mou_signed.pdf). The student roster is included (student_list_redacted.csv); no human-subject PHI will be used in the pilot, IRB approval not required for the synthetic / de-identified benchmark work we’re doing.

Activation date Sept 6 works. Billing contact is Ava Lee (ava@openlab.edu). Please let us know when the credits are provisioned and any activation codes. We’re happy to provide a short case study and highlight Redwood in our partner page.

Warmly,
Lina
